label: Illustrative Florida homeowners policy - 5% hurricane deductible
source: StormShield_Finance_Data_v5.xlsx, sheet 'Sample Policy Summary', built from Fla. Stat. 627.701 and Citizens Property Insurance guidance.
warning: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY - not a declarations page and not policy wording. Citizens states real coverages, deductibles, limits and exclusions vary by policy. Finance must approve this scope before any number leaves the prototype.

deductible.note: Fla. Stat. 627.701 requires insurers to offer $500, 2%, 5% and 10% hurricane-deductible options. The workbook's 'Data Request - Policy Examples' sheet asks for ONE option so worked examples stay internally consistent, and advises against 10%; 5% is the option its 'Sample Policy Summary' sheet already works through ($400,000 Coverage A -> $20,000). The percentage is applied to the documented policy base (Coverage A), never to the damage amount.

out_of_scope_v1: Second-hurricane-same-calendar-year deductible (Fla. Stat. 627.701(5)(a): the greater of the unmet first deductible or the AOP deductible). This engine prices each storm independently and resets the deductible, so a chronological multi-storm year needs a future model.
AOP deductible for non-hurricane wind. Stored here because the statutory rule needs it; unused in v1.
Contents, loss of use, flood and storm surge, premium changes, reinsurance, claim expenses.
Recoverable depreciation withheld until repairs complete under RCV.
